They've been with us as we built the platform from a basic negotiation tool into the only end-to-end drug rate management system in the market. We're grateful for their expertise, focus, and flexibility as we have scaled.”
texts.text: It's been a very positive experience working with the MEV team; MEV is very experienced, methodical, process driven and professional in all that they do! MEV team members provide excellent feature / project / service feedback and suggestions along with proven processes to ensure resource efficiency and high quality deliverables. Our MEV project team is a valued extension of the our core team. We highly recommend MEV to other companies looking to either expand or wholly outsource their software development / engineering needs.

texts.name: “Quantuvis has partnered with MEV for the development of our core product since 2017. They've been with us as we built the platform from a basic negotiation tool into the only end-to-end drug rate management system in the market. We're grateful for their expertise, focus, and flexibility as we have scaled.”
texts.text:
MEV and I closed out the engagement today—very successful.
Given their background in custom software development, they are perhaps an unusual partner for IT DD, but I actually believe this was their strength. Their focus on custom means they are used to unstructured problems where they need to come up with the method AND the solution, which is a great fit for evaluating small businesses because SMB rarely have the ""standard / industry-best-practice"" equipment and tools that you will find in Corporate America. Folks who work on custom also need to be versed in a variety of technologies, not just the latest-and-greatest, which was helpful for my target, which is really old-school and has old tech.

texts.name: Headline
texts.text: Recommended when possible. We review source code and history, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and cost data. This allows us to assess implemented architecture, code quality, technical debt, performance, scalability, dependencies, delivery practices, and other areas directly.
